ansatzcapital-ansatzcapital:lever:39609b.title: Software Engineer
ansatzcapital-ansatzcapital:lever:39609b.description: We are looking for a software engineer to join a lean and technical quantitative trading startup. You’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining scalable trading applications and infrastructure for many financial markets and assist with developing the full stack of infrastructure to support trading operations. The role is fast paced, with daily or even more frequent release cycles, and requires a good sense of prioritization between longer and shorter term needs. Within our systems, from hardware drivers to TCP/multicast handlers to Python interfaces, each layer requires custom optimization for latency, bandwidth, or both. An understanding of trade-offs in terms of clock cycles and CPU cache effects is a must. Multi-core/multi-threaded communications using lock-free algorithms will be employed to increase the theoretical computational limit per unit time; consequently, the candidate should have a good grasp of run-time behavior, serialization delays, and asymptotic behavior in this environment. Compensation consists of base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and possible participation in longer-term incentive schemes.
qualifications: C++11 and higher experience
Excellent design and debugging skills
Experience developing for production critical systems
Excellent communication and prioritization skills
Experience with Python
Experience with x86 hardware
Experience with performance engineering
Understanding of Intel Xeon pipelining and cache behavior
Experience with the TCP networking stack
Experience optimizing Linux kernels / using kernel-bypass networking
Experience leveraging AWS or similar cloud infrastructure

colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:cbdeea3f.title: Part-Time Real Estate Instructor
colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:cbdeea3f.description: At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers, and the community as a whole. We have a rich and storied history. Colibri is one of the pioneers of online professional education, introducing some of the first web-based professional education courses in 2001. Today, the company’s family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets. We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned professionals. To learn more, please visit: www.colibrigroup.com Position Overview We are currently seeking part-time Real Estate Instructors to assist New Mexico students within our online courses for Colibri Group’s esteemed brand, Colibri Real Estate. The instructor will familiarize themselves with our pre-licensing courses and help students understand material by replying to emailed content questions. This is a part-time, contract position with an estimated time commitment of 2-10 hours per week, although that will fluctuate. The instructor is paid an hourly rate based on the number of hours worked assisting students each week, as well as time spent within the other requirements of the position.
responsibilities: Provide all documentation and perform all duties required to become a recognized instructor or Instructor of Record.
Provide support in response to student email, voicemail, and discussion board inquiries.
Provide replies to students within one (1) business day, preferably 24 hours, by email or personal phone. Instructor is not required, nor should the instructor meet personally with students.
Review course content and assist in updates to courses as applicable state law and rule changes occur.
Complete training and remain current on all school technology systems necessary for student support.
Familiarize themselves with the course content and layout.

Complete the 16-hour CDEI (Certified Distance Education Instructor) designation through IDECC (International Distance Education Certification Center – www.IDECC.org ) within 4 months of acceptance of this contract, and Instructor will keep the designation current by taking the CDEI renewal course every three years. Costs for acquisition and renewal are reimbursed by the school.
Instructors of Record may also have additional tasks, depending on state requirements. This list is provided as an example, not a determinate list of tasks.
File proper paperwork with the state commission for school approvals and renewals.
File proper paperwork with the state commission for course approvals and renewals.
Allow name and signature to be used on course completion certificates.
Provide formal reviews of course materials.
Be attentive to and report any real estate commission and regulatory changes that may affect course content or delivery.
Will be required to make a 15-60 minute presentation before the Education Advisory Committee for each of the three pre-license courses. Must be prepared to answer questions about the subject matter.

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Founder & CEO - AI Pathology
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: FOUNDER & CEO — SLIDESTREAM Bringing high-quality pathology to the next billion patients Location: Bangalore (Bengaluru), India Start date: ASAP More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1QRTnTeCQr_LV5k1kmPCqdT9hcpoC53l1Roz1JYLnkYU/edit?slide=id.g3f5248405d1_0_0#slide=id.g3f5248405d1_0_0 Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with a leading global industrial technology partner, we are building a new portfolio of ventures. ABOUT THE VENTURE The blood smear is the frontline test for anaemia, leukaemia, infection and clotting disorders — a drop of blood read cell by cell under a microscope. In tier-2 and tier-3 India it is still read by eye, or often not at all. The reason is structural: Asia has 6.8 pathologists per million people versus 49 in North America, and fewer than 4 per million in much of Africa. The automated digital-morphology systems that could close the gap cost $50k+, out of reach for the small and mid-sized labs that need them, and labs without an on-site pathologist hand ~60% of every test fee to an outside reviewer — economics that only work at a volume they never reach. We are building Slidestream: a sub-€4k scanner, already designed and built by our partner, that photographs the slide, flags abnormal cells with on-board AI, and routes cases to a remote specialist — working offline, with no cloud dependency. The unfair advantage: our partner brings a cleared, low-cost prototype already built and CDSCO-cleared — trained on 5,000+ annotated data points with >80% accuracy on common morphologies, roughly two years of build already done — plus two decades of connected-device fleet management, an embedded compute and manufacturing cost base no medtech startup can match, and 35,000 engineers on the ground in Bengaluru for fast validation and distribution. Two independent investors ranked this concept their #1. OUR OFFER We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start: - €275k of spin-out capital plus a founder stipend + studio budget to build, validate, and launch - Expert Team: Hands-on support across product, growth, fundraising, AI/ML, design, legal, hiring, and more - MVP Build: Full-time venture builder(s) to help ship your first product - Accelerator: 6 months of deep operational support post-launch - Strategic Network: Intros to top-tier investors and corporate partners - Validation: A vetted concept, domain insight, and a head start in a massive market JOBS TO BE DONE As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business. - Define the wedge. Decide the beachhead buyer — private tier-2/3 lab owner vs. government/NGO — and the pricing model (subscription vs. per-use) that gets to revenue fastest. - Take a ready asset to market. Turn the cleared scanner into paying deployments across Indian labs, validating the price point and per-test economics. - Build the network. Recruit and grow the pooled telepathology specialist network that turns a device into a defensible marketplace. - Win the first labs. Land a lighthouse cluster of labs and prove the sample-to-result loop in a single visit. - Leverage partner IP. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7cb9b9d0-42b1-.title: Property Management Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7cb9b9d0-42b1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Portugal. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS. southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:50.title: Account Director, Enterprise (East)
southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:50.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Account Director, you will be responsible for sourcing, closing and activating enterprise customers, while providing critical product feedback to the Cognition team. You will be a crucial contributor to Cognition’s revenue growth and Devin’s development. You’ll work closely with the whole Cognition team including engineering, product and go-to-market to accelerate the sales cycle and help build one of the fastest-growing AI startups. Successful candidates will have deep experience selling highly technical solutions to businesses, have experience with software engineering and exhibit the drive and grit required to win consistently in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. In this role, you will: - Drive revenue for Cognition, owning the entire sales cycle, from prospecting through close and activation for early stage through enterprise companies - Navigate layered customer organizations including working directly with C-suite executives, Tech and AI leaders, procurement and legal stakeholders - Develop strategies for sourcing, demoing the product, and closing opportunities with layered buying organizations - Deeply understand the customer’s technical pain points and priorities, and qualify the best use cases and teams to deploy Devin to large technology organizations - Discover new use cases in our customers’ Tech organizations and overshare customer feedback with our product and engineering teams - Focus on results - generate pipeline, revenue, and help build the best technical sales organization to bring Devin to market Requirements for the role: - ~3+ years of full sales cycle selling experience - Demonstrate a track record of success selling deeply technical products to enterprise customers - You have technical experience - either as a software engineer, sales engineer or forward deployed engineer. If not, you have an exceptional ability to learn and understand the complex technical problems and requirements our customers are trying to solve using Devin - Thrive in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments — you’re willing to move fast and quickly grow in scope and responsibility - You have a demonstrated exceptional ability to learn You might excel if you… - previously founded a startup - successfully sourced and closed large, complex enterprise software deals - were a software engineer or sales engineer, or studied computer science, but moved into go-to market roles to be closer to the customer - are interested in AI tooling, a tinkerer, and generally are a power user of such tools - are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high-intensity environments *** This role is onsite in NYC, SF, or Austin *** EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.
